versions.description_html:
Master Git Branching Strategies with a clear breakdown of Gitflow, GitHub Flow, and trunk-based development. Learn pull requests, merging, and rebasing.

Branching sounds like a small detail until two people change the same file. Then someone has to figure out which version is the real one, and that's a branching problem.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a branch is
  • Why branching strategies exist
  • The three building blocks
  • Git Flow, the structured one
  • GitHub Flow, the simple one
  • Trunk-based development, the fast one
  • Pull requests explained
  • Merge versus rebase
  • Choosing a strategy for small and large teams
  • Common mistakes beginners make
  • Which one fits you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
